label: Cases
purpose: One synthetic study id per case: which protocol was followed and what the outcome was. No names, no dates of birth, no free text about a person. Sensitive; public_fields is empty so nothing here is ever projected.

desks.lens: triage orders the questions a clinician asks next; it never answers them
desks.constraint: never a diagnosis; outputs are ordered questions that cite the protocol step they come from

desks.lens: an audit compares what the protocol says with what the case record shows, step by step
desks.constraint: works on synthetic case ids only; never joins cases to any external identifier

expected: timeline view orders cases by opened_on
no field of a case ever appears in a projection (public_fields is empty)

done_definition: Done as prototype when dotfield prove cases exits 0 and a render --for another person shows nothing from this room; the pack stays draft until its README conditions are met.
